basic_info.description: Step into Onyx Residence 302, a beautifully designed one-bedroom home overlooking Jackson Playground in one of San Francisco's sunniest locations, adjacent to the Design District. Crafted by Gould Evans, this residence exemplifies modern urban living, with natural light, an open floor plan, and top-notch materials as its focal points. Meticulously maintained by its original owners, the design and features speak for themselves. Deeded parking, an additional deeded storage space, and a common area roof deck with city views, as well as high-speed internet, are included with your HOA dues. For convenience, Whole Foods is a block away, with Philz Coffee and Milkbomb directly downstairs. Chase Center and Mission Bay are just around the corner, either a short Uber ride or an easy walk if you're getting your steps in. Beyond the high-end finishes, the building fosters a strong sense of community. Neighbors connect through resident groups, while well-insulated walls ensure peace and quiet when you're home. Whether unwinding inside or enjoying the rooftop deck with city views, this home offers the perfect urban retreat.
